investigation_notes.Script Summary: Base64-encoded PowerShell decoded to logic that checks the hosts file and, if missing, appends the entry '195.55.224.28 update.microsoft.com' to redirect Windows Update to an external IP.
investigation_notes.Reputation Notes: External IP (195.55.224.28) shows low abuse score from IP reputation lookup, while the process hash shows 0/engines detections but has mixed community votes indicating suspicion.
investigation_notes.Description: A Base64-encoded PowerShell command executed on WKSTN-RND-07 under the SYSTEM account decoded to a script that would add a hosts-file entry redirecting update.microsoft.com to 195.55.224.28. The executable's hash has no AV detections but has community-sourced suspicion, and the action targets a critical update domain. Because the behavior modifies system host resolution for a Windows update domain and was executed as SYSTEM, this represents potentially malicious activity and is escalated as high priority.
